tasks.label: Run Orgni API server with external intelligence
Check PostgreSQL readiness
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test pg_isready -U postgres -d orgni

tasks.label: Check Orgni database schema
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U postgres -d orgni -c "\dt"

tasks.label: Check Orgni database tables
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U orgni -d orgni -c "\dt"

tasks.label: Inspect accounts schema
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U orgni -d orgni -c "\d accounts"

tasks.label: Inspect account columns
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U orgni -d orgni -c "select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name='accounts' order by ordinal_position"

tasks.label: Inspect account columns safely
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U orgni -d orgni -c 'select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name = ''accounts'' order by ordinal_position'

tasks.label: Restart API with local database
tasks.command: $connection = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connection) { Stop-Process -Id $connection.OwningProcess -Force }; $env:DATABASE_URL='postgresql://orgni:testpass@127.0.0.1:55432/orgni'; $env:DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8000'; $env:PORT='8080'; pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server dev

tasks.label: Inspect test database tables
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U orgni -d orgni -c "select tablename from pg_tables where schemaname = 'public' order by tablename"

tasks.label: Clear test auth database
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U orgni -d orgni -c 'TRUNCATE TABLE public.accounts, public.api_keys, public.approval_policies, public.capabilities, public.connections, public.email_verifications, public.external_identities, public.facts, public.members, public.microsoft_connections, public.organisations, public.orgni_actions, public.password_resets, public.permissions_state, public.processed_teams_activities, public.reviews, public.sources, public.teams_audit_log, public.teams_conversations, public.teams_integration, public.tokens RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;'

tasks.label: Verify empty test database
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U orgni -d orgni -c 'select count(*) as accounts from public.accounts; select count(*) as organisations from public.organisations; select count(*) as members from public.members; select count(*) as email_verifications from public.email_verifications; select count(*) as password_resets from public.password_resets;'

tasks.label: Run API with email verification
tasks.command: $envFile = 'artifacts\api-server\.env'; Get-Content $envFile | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\s*([^#=][^=]*)=(.*)$') { $name = $matches[1].Trim(); $value = $matches[2].Trim(); if ($value.Length -gt 0) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $value, 'Process') } } }; $env:DATABASE_URL='postgresql://orgni:testpass@127.0.0.1:55432/orgni'; $env:DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8000'; $env:PORT='8080'; pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server dev

tasks.label: Verify pending registration flow
tasks.command: $body = @{ email = 'verification-check@example.com'; organization = 'Verification Check'; password = 'correct horse battery staple'; confirmPassword = 'correct horse battery staple' } | ConvertTo-Json; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/auth/register' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; "Status: $($response.StatusCode)"; $response.Content } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); "Status: $([int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode)"; $reader.ReadToEnd() } else { throw } }

tasks.label: Test email verification registration
tasks.command: $body = @{ email = 'verification-check@example.com'; organization = 'Verification Check'; password = 'correct horse battery staple'; confirmPassword = 'correct horse battery staple' } | ConvertTo-Json; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/auth/register' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body; Write-Output ("Status: " + $response.StatusCode); Write-Output $response.Content } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream()); Write-Output ("Status: " + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode); Write-Output $reader.ReadToEnd() } else { throw } }

tasks.label: Reset test database after flow test
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U orgni -d orgni -c 'TRUNCATE TABLE public.accounts, public.api_keys, public.approval_policies, public.capabilities, public.connections, public.email_verifications, public.external_identities, public.facts, public.members, public.microsoft_connections, public.organisations, public.orgni_actions, public.password_resets, public.permissions_state, public.processed_teams_activities, public.reviews, public.sources, public.teams_audit_log, public.teams_conversations, public.teams_integration, public.tokens RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;'

tasks.label: Restart API with automatic env loading
tasks.command: $connection = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connection) { Stop-Process -Id $connection.OwningProcess -Force }; pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server dev

tasks.label: Verify email verification response
tasks.command: node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/auth/register',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({email:'verification-check@example.com',organization:'Verification Check',password:'correct horse battery staple',confirmPassword:'correct horse battery staple'})}).then(async r=>console.log(r.status,await r.text()))"

tasks.label: Verify registration verification gate
tasks.command: curl.exe -sS -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/auth/register -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data "{\"email\":\"verification-check@example.com\",\"organization\":\"Verification Check\",\"password\":\"correct horse battery staple\",\"confirmPassword\":\"correct horse battery staple\"}"

tasks.label: Verify email verification gate
tasks.command: $payload = @{ email = 'fresh-verification@example.com'; organization = 'Fresh Verification'; password = 'correct horse battery staple'; confirmPassword = 'correct horse battery staple' } | ConvertTo-Json; try { $result = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/auth/register' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $payload; Write-Output ('pendingVerification=' + $result.pendingVerification); Write-Output ('email=' + $result.email) } catch { Write-Output $_.Exception.Message; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Clean verification test account
tasks.command: docker exec orgni-auth-test psql -U orgni -d orgni -c 'TRUNCATE TABLE public.accounts, public.api_keys, public.approval_policies, public.capabilities, public.connections, public.email_verifications, public.external_identities, public.facts, public.members, public.microsoft_connections, public.organisations, public.orgni_actions, public.password_resets, public.permissions_state, public.processed_teams_activities, public.reviews, public.sources, public.teams_audit_log, public.teams_conversations, public.teams_integration, public.tokens RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;'

tasks.label: Correct auth screenshot names
tasks.command: $screenshots = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'screenshots'; $temp = Join-Path $screenshots 'verification-email.tmp.png'; Move-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $screenshots 'sign-in.png') -Destination $temp -Force; Move-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $screenshots 'verification-pending.png') -Destination (Join-Path $screenshots 'sign-in.png') -Force; Move-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Destination (Join-Path $screenshots 'verification-email.png') -Force; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $screenshots -File | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name

tasks.label: Inspect final auth diff
tasks.command: git diff --check; git status --short; git diff --stat
